acceptance: A held record with a ship_window_held WAIT gets a real audit report by the next boundary without an operator step
The retry runs only when no ship window or ship.lock is held (test)
fix: At the boundary (or the wave-end step), list held records whose audit report is WAIT ship_window_held or port_not_wired and run the same dispatch through `landing audit`, idempotent per tree.
summary: H4 (held-proposal-adversarial-audit-dispatch) records WAIT ship_window_held when the orchestrator still holds the ship window after a fleet-rebase recovery, and launches nothing. Nothing drives the retry: it rides the next ship try of that cycle or a manual `evolve landing audit --cycle N`.
title: A held audit that waited on a held ship window is retried by the pipeline
